page.notes: Page-number and running head as printed. The right column is cut at its outer edge by the fold and the neighbouring page: the ends of the lines "ap", "ideneus", "impugnari", "minimo" and the entries after "veni" are partly lost, so those words are marked illegible or uncertain. The fragment "veni" at the far right below "*Nomine filiorum nepotes" is cut off and not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "pulari" (possibly a corrupted word), "lucri", "181,15" (a stray mark before 15), "57,1", "con-cere" (the word is partly hidden by the rule), and the opening "su" of "suscipere", which is hidden at the column edge. The signature "Bbb 3" is faint and may be partly show-through. Show-through of the neighbouring page at the right edge is excluded.
